title: Senior Process Engineer
job_description:
Senior Process Engineer

Role Summary

Novoloop is seeking a hands-on Senior Process Engineer to support process scale-up, capital-project execution, commissioning, start-up, and plant optimization.

This individual will serve as a technical owner across the project lifecycle, working directly with internal teams, EPC firms, technology licensors, equipment vendors, and plant personnel. The ideal candidate combines strong process-design fundamentals with practical plant and commissioning experience.

Location: Remote in the US, with frequent travel to China demo plant (2-3 times the rest of 2026, then have the ability to stay in China for 4+ weeks for commissioning)

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or advanced degree in chemical engineering or a related discipline.
8+ years of relevant experience in chemical-process engineering, capital projects, commissioning, or plant operations.
Experience with both FEED and detailed engineering for chemical or industrial process facilities.
Hands-on commissioning, start-up, plant-operations, or process-troubleshooting experience.
Strong knowledge of process equipment, utilities, controls, PFDs, P&IDs, and heat and material balances.
Experience overseeing EPC firms, technology licensors, or equipment vendors from the owner’s perspective.
Working knowledge of Process Safety Management systems and tools, including HAZOP, LOPA, Management of Change, facility siting, Process Safety Information, incident investigation, and root-cause analysis.
Fluent English and demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with international EPCs, vendors, and plant teams.
Ability to travel internationally, including to project and manufacturing sites in China.
Experience with techno-economic analysis (TEA) and COGS-reduction initiatives.
Experience with EPC selection, contractor interviews, and techno-economic bid evaluation.
Experience preparing or reviewing equipment datasheets, specifications, and vendor documents.
Experience providing technical sign-off of equipment prior to fabrication.
Experience with FAT/eFAT and vendor acceptance testing.
Construction-support experience, including RFIs, field changes, and engineering redlines.
Experience with pre-commissioning and commissioning planning.
Capital-project execution experience, including FEL packages, contractor management, and schedule and cost control.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong preference: Mandarin Chinese proficiency.
Strong preference: Scale-up experience from laboratory or pilot scale to demonstration or commercial operation.
First-of-a-kind technology experience.
Experience with wiped-film, falling-film, or forced-circulation evaporators.
Experience with nitric acid absorption or other nitric-acid processes.
Experience with ProSim or comparable process-simulation software.
Familiarity with PDRI or comparable capital-project assessment tools.
Experience with reaction kinetics, operations readiness, and plant-personnel training.
Professional Engineer license or equivalent registration.

Engineering Team Deliverables

A validated process design basis for Novoloop’s demonstration plant and first commercial plant — PFDs, P&IDs, heat and material balances, and simulation models the organization can build from.
FEED and detailed-engineering packages accepted by internal stakeholders and EPC partners, with technical scopes, datasheets, and specifications complete enough to bid and fabricate against.
Equipment and vendor packages taken from bid evaluation through technical sign-off, FAT/eFAT, and delivery — on scope, on schedule, and fit for the intended duty.
Process-safety deliverables closed out for each project stage: HAZOP and LOPA actions, facility siting, Process Safety Information, and Management of Change records.
Successful commissioning and start-up: pre-commissioning plans executed, performance-test criteria met, and the plant handed to operations at demonstrated rate and quality.
Documented improvements in throughput, yield, reliability, energy use, CAPEX, and COGS, with the underlying analysis captured for the next facility.
Design, procedural, and training improvements informed by plant learning are fed back into Novoloop’s future commercial facilities in the US and China.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

401(k)
401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Referral program
Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

1) Briefly describe your experience in scaling new chemical technology - what scale did you start from and eventually finished at? Did the plant succeed?

2) How much experience do you have designing chemical plants? Which design phases are you experienced in? What size of plant and what product?
3) What's your experience in new plant commissioning and startup?
4) What's your experience in plant operation?

Are you willing to travel to China for demo plant-related work trips?

Experience:

chemical engineering and plant design: 8 years (Required)

Language:

Mandarin (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote
